prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent hero illustration for the existing academic website RESEARCH ATLAS at 300px wide.
Primary request: restyle the research atlas object group to match the comic icon style of reference image 1 exactly. Image 1 is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE only, image 2 is SUBJECT AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE. A crisp, friendly academic gaming inventory illustration: open ocean-blue research notebook with ivory pages and an apricot ribbon, supporting a small geometric orbital model with connected nodes, plus a short pencil. Match image 1's bold dark navy outlines, smooth simplified comic shapes, flat two-tone cel shading and restrained detail, rather than the old painted antique brass style. Orbit rings apricot orange, nodes ocean blue, model base navy. Book has one simple triangle-and-nodes drawing, no text.
Palette: ocean #285a83, light blue #78a7c9, apricot #eaa05e, ivory #f5ecdd, dark outline #23384d. No gold or metallic textures.
Composition: single compact centered object group, three-quarter view, square framing, all objects visible with 5% transparent margin. Notebook and orbital model remain clearly recognizable at 120px. Actual transparent background, no checkerboard, no glow, no rectangle or environment, no lettering or watermark. Clean alpha edges and local contact shadows only.
